zone: Asia/Saigon note: dates are US calendar dates of the scheduled FOMC policy statement (last day of the meeting)
source: Federal Reserve Board official pages. 1985-2020: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical{year}.htm . 2021-2026: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm fetched 2026-11-15.
rule: Scheduled regular meetings only. Excluded: conference calls, unscheduled/emergency meetings, cancelled meetings, notation votes. Two-day meetings use the last day (statement/announcement day). Two consecutive one-day Meeting lines with a single minutes release are treated as one meeting on the later day (2003-09-16).
